home.heroTitle: Trello brings all your tasks, teammates, and tools together
home.heroSubtitle: Keep everything in the same place — even if your team isn’t. Organize work, streamline workflows, and collaborate seamlessly with intuitive Kanban boards.
home.mockCard2: Design system UI kit & dark mode palettes
home.mockCard5: Board Close, Reopen & Permanent Cascading Delete
home.capabilitiesTitle: Everything you need to stay in flow
home.capabilitiesSubtitle: From personal daily tasks to collaborative team workflows, our Kanban system provides all the tools required for maximum productivity.
home.feature1Desc: Fluid drag-and-drop cards between columns. Reorder lists, clone tasks, and manage project workflows effortlessly.
home.feature2Desc: Set due dates with smart deadline indicators (Overdue, Due Soon, Completed) and track subtask progress with live % bars.
home.feature3Desc: Customize board wallpapers with Unsplash photos, gradients, or upload your own image files directly to Cloudinary.
home.feature4Desc: Invite teammates by email with real-time socket notifications, assign card members, and collaborate in rich activity threads.
home.deepTitle: Cards that carry every single detail
home.deepDesc: Every card is a self-contained hub for productivity. Attach files, configure colorful customizable label strips, write comprehensive descriptions, and track feedback with editable comments.
home.deepPoint1: File attachments with instant make-cover previews
home.deepPoint2: Color-coded labels with title search and quick filters
home.deepPoint3: Duplicate and move cards between lists in a click
home.archiveTitle: Peace of mind with Archive & Reopen
home.archiveDescPrefix: Finished a sprint or closed a project? Archive cards and columns without losing valuable history. Access the dedicated
home.archiveDescSuffix: anytime to restore or permanently clean up.
home.securityNote: Owner-only board close and permanent cascading deletion safeguards your critical data.
home.ctaSubtitle: Start managing your projects, ideas, and team tasks with clarity and speed today.

onboarding.step1Subtitle: A visual workspace designed to help you organize projects, manage daily tasks, and boost team productivity.
onboarding.step1H1: Create unlimited dedicated Boards for projects, personal goals, or team workflows.
onboarding.step1H2: Full Dark Mode & Light Mode support with smooth, eye-friendly transitions.
onboarding.step1H3: Easily manage active and archived boards with one-click restore or permanent delete.
onboarding.step2Subtitle: Seamlessly visualize your workflow from To Do -> In Progress -> Done with fluid drag-and-drop.
onboarding.step2H1: Smoothly reorder columns and cards with modern dnd-kit touch and mouse gestures.
onboarding.step2H2: Instantly duplicate (Copy) or move cards across columns on the board.
onboarding.step2H3: Compose rich task descriptions using the built-in formatted Markdown Editor.
onboarding.step3Subtitle: Break down complex goals into actionable sub-tasks and track deadlines with ease.
onboarding.step3H1: Create multiple checklists per card with real-time percentage progress bars.
onboarding.step3H2: Set precise Due Dates with smart countdown countdown badges.
onboarding.step3H3: Automated color badges: Green (Completed), Amber (Due within 24h), Red (Overdue).
onboarding.step4Subtitle: Give your workspace personality and recognize task priority at a single glance.
onboarding.step4H1: Attach multi-colored Labels with custom titles (Urgent, Bug, Feature, Design, etc.).
onboarding.step4H2: Customize board backgrounds from curated Unsplash photos or upload your own via Cloudinary.
onboarding.step4H3: Filter cards instantly by labels, keywords, or assigned team members.
onboarding.step5Subtitle: Connect with teammates, discuss in card comments, and stay synchronized in real time.
onboarding.step5H1: Invite members to your boards via email with clear role permissions.
onboarding.step5H2: Comment on cards and receive instant notification alerts powered by Socket.io.
onboarding.step5H3: Archive completed lists and cards to keep your workspace tidy, with one-click restore anytime.
